$comment: Provenance for the vendored OpenSCAD copy. Every file below is copied verbatim from the upstream repository at the recorded tag, except where a note says otherwise. Edit them upstream, never here. Each sha256 is of the bytes this repo ships, which for a file with an 'edited on copy' note is deliberately not the upstream hash; tests/test_vendored_openscad.py fails if any file drifts from its record.

Braille_Cylinder_STL_Generator.scad.note: The MakerWorld single-file build of the Version 1 model is vendored rather than the dual-file desktop build, so the download is self-contained (no include <presets.scad>). Renamed on copy: this repo ships one file, so the _MakerWorld_v1.5 suffix would only confuse. Upstream renamed this file from _v2 to _v1.5 on 2026-09-01; its _v2 file is now the separate Embosser Version 2 generator, which is NOT vendored here.

PARAMETER_MAPPING.md.note: One sentence edited on copy: upstream says 'this repository contains only the OpenSCAD cylinder generator', which is false here. The hash covers the edited copy, so it still catches later drift.
